announce_ar: بدأ احتفال العيد السنوي (Anniversary Invitation)! دوس على الزرار اللي فوق.
announce_en: To celebrate our anniversary, we cordially invite you to join in the celebration! Click the anniversary button at the top.
end_ar: انتهى احتفال العيد السنوي. نشوفكم السنة الجاية!
end_en: Thank you for journeying with us! Though the anniversary celebration has concluded, we wish you continued adventures in the world of CO. See you next year!
